content_of_post_to_comment:
I think trying to suddenly go from 10+ hours scrolling → perfect morning routine + hours of studying is probably making this harder than it needs to be.

I’d make the “minimum version” almost stupidly easy.

For example:

STUDY

High → proper study session

Medium → 25 mins

Low → open the course + do 5 mins

MORNING

High → full routine

Medium → wash/get dressed/breakfast

Low → get out of bed + wash face

The low version STILL counts. The goal initially is getting yourself to repeatedly start the behaviour again.

Full disclosure: I’m a junior doctor and got so interested in this approach after rebuilding my own routines following a 5-month hospitalisation for depression that I built a free tool around it — Dopamine-Charts.

It lets you create high/medium/low-energy versions of habits and also looks at WHY they keep failing — cues, friction, habit linking etc.

Might be useful here, but either way I’d start ridiculously small rather than trying to fix your whole life on Monday.
